title: ruta bungei
intro: Ruta bungei, commonly known as the desert rue or Bunge's rue, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. The health benefits of Ruta bungei include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and reduce the risk of infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its use as a topical treatment for wounds, burns, and eczema, as well as its potential to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Ruta bungei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
